title: Trust biñ dénk dex gi
intro: Amna ruuh bu jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe yu kenn mënul am, maanaam dundu xale buy sooga judd dafa nekkoon ci jafe-jafe. Ñu topp ndigal lu jaarul yoon, ñu daal di dugal kumpa bu am solo ci ndox mi, waaye ñu delloo ko ci anam wuñu ko xamul woon.
clues: Maa ngi dundu ci lëndëmu benn jaay doole bu santaane ñu ray xale yu góor yiy sooga judd.
Dafa am royuwaay bu Yàlla daal di ñëw ci man, digal ma ma jël dogal bu tiis lool te tiis lool ci sama xol.
Ma dugal sama liir bu baax bi ci kees, daal di koy teg ci kaw dex giy wal.
Sama xol jeex, daanaka ma génne kumpa gi, waaye Yàlla dafa dëgëral sama dogal.
Ma yónnee kenn mu topp tukkib xale bi wàcci dex gi ndax ndox mi dafa yóbbu xët wi.
Xale bi waa kër tiran bi gis nañu ko, ginaaw ga ma gis sama doom, ma nekk ki koy yar.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Mu def doomam ci kees, daal di koy teg ci dex gi.
Dafa nëbb doomam ci lëmu doj
Dafa bàyyi doomam ci desert bi
Dafa bàyyi doomam ci buntu benn jumaa
trial.answer: Mu def doomam ci kees, daal di koy teg ci dex gi.

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Benn kees buñ def ci kaw dex gi
Taabal bu fees dell ak lekk yu bawoo ci asamaan si
Gaam bu jigéen ñu yónnee ko muy firnde
location.answer: Benn kees buñ def ci kaw dex gi

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Mu dajewaat ak doomam, daal di koy nàmp
Dafa dem ci beneen réew, dëkk ci exile
outcome.answer: Mu dajewaat ak doomam, daal di koy nàmp

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
